policy.experimental: May be incomplete, provider-dependent, or changing. No compatibility promise.
policy.preview: Implemented with real source depth, tests, examples and documentation, but API/support may still change.
policy.stable: Preview requirements plus negative tests, security notes and verified compatibility across every supported compiler release.
policy.core: Stable requirements plus at least two stable release cycles, migration policy, verified offline installation and an identified maintainer.

note: The conservative default is intentional. Packages are promoted explicitly only after tools/package-quality.mjs shows the requested level is supported by evidence.
